venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 9/25 (MOD & Chef KE / JMS; nice all around).** Net $11,199 vs target $10,833 (+3.4%). Food $328, event sales $1,559. Comps $54.30 / 0.5%. 332 guests at $29.04 check average. A decent Friday night — the film festival crowd arrived a bit later than expected, around 9pm, but filled out the room nicely for guests and staff alike. Dolly night was a hit: staff wore pink, the DJ mixed in Dolly and other country music, and several guests came dressed in Dolly gear and wigs. Kitchen smooth sailing. Film Festival group was pleasant throughout and had their tab voided as a courtesy. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the whole room singing along when Jolene inevitably played. Entered by BT.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Cloudy morning, sunny and temperate day
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 9/25 (AM Franck & Shannon; PM Justin & Shannon/Marcus; cloudy morning, sunny and temperate day).** Total net sales $14,465 vs target $4,387 (+229.7%). Municipal Bar morning $1,837, evening $8,685, Sun Club $37, Hot Eye $2,896. No food or event sales recorded. Comps $216. 263 guests (22 morning + 241 evening, OpenTable). Good start right at 8am with hotel guest groups, then quiet until 11, with a few larger tours and steady walk-ins through the afternoon. Evening was busy all night — a Dolly Parton tribute screening next door brought a wave of guests before and after, reservations were strong, and walk-ins were up as (false?) fall weather set in; the bar ran three bartenders and a server short but the floor team covered smoothly, with the whole bar full from 6 until close. Sun Club had a really good day with strong food and drink sales. Hot Eye was packed at 8pm; Brother Vinyl started their set early to a full room, a short lull around 10:30 for reset before filling back up until midnight, with a killer set and phenomenal energy. Kitchen busy, running low on strips and tartare, expecting a heavy prep day; happy heading into busy season. Maintenance: Hot Eye's back bar lights stopped working. No incidents. Favorite moment: Dolly wigs and sequins everywhere in tribute, plus a regular stopping by with friends and a guest showing off the space to new friends. Entered by Alexis.
